review_evidence: TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite/Basic.lean: defines IsPositiveDefinite predicate and proves 30+ theorems (map_zero_nonneg, conj_symm, normSq_le, posSemidef, add, mul, sum, prod, etc.)
TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite/AddGroup.lean: defines WithNegStar type synonym, IsPositiveDefiniteSub predicate, and proves transfer theorems, continuity, normalization, pullbacks
TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite/Continuity.lean: proves local continuity estimates and uniformContinuous_of_continuousAt_zero_of_forall_star_eq_neg via 3×3 Gram matrix calculation
TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite/Function/Kernel.lean: proves isPositiveDefinite_iff_posSemidef equivalence and subtraction-form specialization
TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite/Kernel/Kolmogorov.lean: constructs KolmogorovSpace, kolmogorovFeature, inner_kolmogorovFeature, and universal isometry/equivalence
TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite/Kernel/Finsupp.lean: defines positiveDefiniteKernelFinsuppForm and proves sesquilinearity, conjugate symmetry, and posSemidef on coefficient space
TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite/Function/Closure.lean: proves weighted sum_smul, sum_real_smul, pow, and normalization-at-origin lemmas
TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite/Function/Difference.lean: proves sub_shift, neg_one_pow_mul_fwdDiff_iter, alternating_sum for bounded PD functions
TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite/Function/GNS.lean: builds GNS translation representation, gnsTranslation, gnsRepresentation, and proves strong continuity
TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite/SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean: defines IsSemigroupGroupPD on ℝ≥0×V, proves posSemidef, conj_symm, diagonal lemmas, closure properties
TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite/SemigroupGroup/FourierLaplace/Basic.lean: defines laplaceAtom, fourierAtom, and proves isSemigroupGroupPD_laplaceFourierAtom
TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite/SemigroupGroup/FourierLaplace/Transform.lean: defines laplaceFourierTransform, RepresentsLaplaceFourier, and measure operations
TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite/Kernel/Shift.lean: proves posSemidef_sub_comp_shift for symmetric shifts via Hankel matrix moment estimate
TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite/SemigroupGroup/Time/Axis.lean: proves timeAxis_isPositiveDefinite, complete monotonicity (alternating sums, forward differences, antitone real part)
summary: I inspected 15 files spanning the TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite hierarchy (Basic, AddGroup, Continuity, Function/Kernel, Function/Closure, Function/Difference, Function/GNS, Kernel/Bounds, Kernel/Finsupp, Kernel/Kolmogorov, Kernel/Shift, Kernel/Universal, SemigroupGroup/Basic, SemigroupGroup/Product, SemigroupGroup/FourierLaplace/Basic, SemigroupGroup/FourierLaplace/Transform, SemigroupGroup/Time/Axis, AdditiveCharacter, FourierAtom, Limits, Normalize, PontryaginMeasure, Pullback, SemigroupGroup/Normalize, SemigroupGroup/Pullback, SemigroupGroup/Time/Difference). Every file contains formal mathematical declarations (definitions, theorems, lemmas with proofs) relevant to positive-definite functions, kernels, Bochner/BCR theory, GNS/Kolmogorov constructions, and Fourier-Laplace representation. No file is a pure import aggregator; even AddGroup.lean, which imports several modules, defines WithNegStar, IsPositiveDefiniteSub, and a full API. All files contribute unique searchable formal mathematics.
